summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 4 August 2026, providing notice of redemption of its £1,000,000,000 Fixed to Fixed Rate Reset Tier 2 Notes due 28 November 2031 (ISIN: XS2346516250). The redemption occurs on 28 August 2026 at par, plus accrued interest, pursuant to Condition 5(d) (Call Option). The registrant is the issuer exercising its call option on outstanding debt. This is a routine debt management action, not a special-situation corporate event. Watch for the redemption date and completion of payment, but no risk-arb angle applies.
